resource_kpi_keywords = ['cpu', 'mem', 'memory', 'disk', 'network', 'io', 'load', 'swap', 'queue', 'packet', 'traffic']

# Define traffic or business KPIs keywords for lower threshold anomaly detection
traffic_kpi_keywords = ['success', 'succee', 'rate', 'tps', 'throughput', 'num', 'count', 'session', 'connect', 'login']

# Helper function to identify if KPI name matches any keyword list (case insensitive)
def kpi_matches(kpi_name, keywords):
    kpi_name_lower = kpi_name.lower()
    return any(keyword in kpi_name_lower for keyword in keywords)

# Calculate global P5 and P15 thresholds for traffic/business KPIs for anomaly detection
def calculate_global_lower_thresholds(df, quantiles=[0.05, 0.15]):
    lower_thresholds = df.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'name'])['value'].quantile(quantiles).unstack(level=-1)
    lower_thresholds.columns = [f'p{int(q*100)}' for q in quantiles]
    lower_thresholds = lower_thresholds.reset_index()
    return lower_thresholds

# Calculate global lower thresholds for traffic/business KPIs using entire metric_df
lower_thresholds = calculate_global_lower_thresholds(metric_df)

# Merge global thresholds with filtered data for anomaly detection
def merge_thresholds(filtered_df, upper_thresholds, lower_thresholds):
    df = filtered_df.copy()
    df = df.merge(upper_thresholds, on=['cmdb_id', 'name'], how='left')
    df = df.merge(lower_thresholds, on=['cmdb_id', 'name'], how='left')
    return df

    mask = df.apply(lambda row: (
        pd.notna(row['p95_threshold']) and
        kpi_matches(row['name'], resource_kpi_keywords) and
        row['value'] > row['p95_threshold']
    ), axis=1)
    return df[mask]

# Detect anomalies for traffic/business KPIs (value < P5 or P15 threshold)

    mask = df.apply(lambda row: (
        pd.notna(row['p5']) and
        kpi_matches(row['name'], traffic_kpi_keywords) and
        (row['value'] < row['p5'] or (pd.notna(row['p15']) and row['value'] < row['p15']))
    ), axis=1)
    return df[mask]
